title: Inclusive ASR for Disfluent Speech: Cascaded Large-Scale Self-Supervised Learning with Targeted Fine-Tuning and Data Augmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating accuracy bias by comparing Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance metrics, specifically Word Error Rate (WER) and BERTScore, on a dataset of stuttered/disfluent speech (FluencyBank) against a baseline of synthesized non-disfluent speech (FluencyBank-N).
